build_furthest_point_sampling: build a module that uses furthest_point_sample to select npoint features with largest minimum distance from a point cloud
build_gather_operation: build a module that uses gather_operation to gather features at specified index positions from a tensor
build_three_nn: build a module that uses three_nn to find the three nearest neighbors of unknown points in known points
build_three_interpolate: build a module that uses three_interpolate to perform weighted linear interpolation on three nearest neighbor features
build_query_and_group: build a module that uses QueryAndGroup to perform ball query and group features within a radius around centroids
